notes.title: Snow Cone Demo available for ANZ Indie Showcase 2025
notes.notes: [p]We're stoked that Snow Cone is part of the awesome line-up of games featured in the ANZ Indie Showcase this year. Thanks to everyone at The Indie Brew team for making this event happen![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Snow Cone demo is available to play throughout the entire Steam event until 11th September.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate, we're broadcasting a playthrough of the Snow Cone demo over the weekend. We hope the broadcast gives new players a good idea of Snow Cone's vibes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for joining us on this journey of making Snow Cone![/p][p][/p][p]-Ben 💜[/p]

notes.title: Snow Cone Demo (0.9.4.1) Rolls into Frosty Games Fest!
notes.notes:
Good news! We are keeping the demo up for the premier of [url=https://www.frostygamesfest.com/]Frosty Games Fest[/url]!

Frosty Games Fest will showcase upcoming and recently released games made across Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand.

We're super happy Snow Cone was selected for the showcase – thanks to the team at Frosty Games Fest for hosting this event!

The Snow Cone demo will be available to play until 23 June AEST. After this, we'll be taking it down to continue making improvements.

– Ben 💜

notes.title: Snow Cone Demo (0.9.4.1) available now!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to be part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase with an updated version of the demo.

We’ve made the following changes:
[list]
[*] Several level changes for a smoother difficulty curve
[*] A couple brand new levels
[*] A new character: Vinny
[*] A dedicated (optional!) Hint button
[/list]
Cerebral Puzzle Showcase runs until 6 June (PDT) and is presented by Draknek & Friends who develop and publish some of the best puzzle games around!

We hope you enjoy playing the demo!

- Jack 🐞

notes.title: We removed the last level. It was bad.
notes.notes:
I made a mistake by using a bad level as the final level in the demo. I included it because it was tempting to have a really 'over the top' level as the finale. But seeing it through players' eyes made it clear it was more frustrating and unfair than interesting or fun and didn't provide value to the game. 

For now, I have removed the level entirely so that players can actually complete the demo and experience the final outro dialogue.

So, if you have been stuck on level 3-5, I apologise and encourage to you re-play level 3-4 to trigger the end of the demo and get some closure!

Regards,
Jack
